source_identity: Actual file SHA256s take precedence over advancing shared-checkout HEAD; each run retains its observed HEAD.
objective: Complete the specified theory's mathematical and physical obligations using explicit framework premises, and certify established mathematical implications in Lean.

interpretation.axiomatic_certification: Prove exact consequences conditional on the nine current v2 postulates and every additional supplied physical premise. Choosing a postulate does not derive it.
interpretation.mechanistic_closure: Derive the law, transport, reactions, receiver and metric response from one specified admissible dynamics without injecting the target. Apply CFG678/679 prospectively.
interpretation.empirical_validation: Compare predictions of that closed framework to observations with explicitly justified inference assumptions, free parameters and held-out tests.
interpretation.priority: Preserve dated sources, correspondence, provenance, authorship metadata and a reproducible content-hashed snapshot. Local hashes alone are neither public timestamping nor a guarantee against independent discoveries.

excluded_as_unconditional_evidence: Inherited Lambda-CDM expansion, EH initial spectrum, backscaled growth, cosmological abundance and turnaround supply
Standard MOND comparator's free function, EFE, metric assumptions or outcomes silently used as framework premises
A target profile or law-shaped functional form inserted into the alleged selecting mechanism
Numerical positivity or equilibrium recovery promoted to continuum well-posedness or universal attraction
Agreement between AI agents promoted to physical proof
permitted_with_explicit_labels: The framework's own declared phenomenological law and coefficient when proving conditional mathematical consequences
General mathematical facts, exact real/rational algebra and justified geometry
Observed data with a declared measurement/inference model
Borrowed models as labelled comparators or conditional benchmarks, with both successes and failures retaining their dependencies
completion_requires: Exact fields, equations, units, domains, boundary and initial conditions
A specified target-free selector and conserved same-system reciprocal reactions and receiver
Admissible existence, positivity, well-posedness, stability and attraction in the claimed regimes
One healthy metric producing dynamics, lensing and gravitational-wave/local-gravity predictions
A framework-derived background and perturbations or a proved regime of equivalence to any imported functions
A theorem-to-English map covering every mathematical claim, kernel proofs and axiom reports
Finite computation manifests, informative controls, numerical/implementation error bounds appropriate to each claim
Honest empirical scorecard including failed, conditional and pending measurements
For any separately adopted TOE scope, the additional quantum and Standard-Model derivations
status_policy: A scoped mathematical certificate can pass while mechanistic and empirical closure remain open. No percentage completion is inferred from theorem counts.
